_comment: Per-map symbol manifest of the PSX overlay data the engine reads as map tables (tables.json). va: the address in the overlay (array data at va - base in gamedata/raw/<bin>); bytes: how many bytes sh::maps::MapTables copies (the ROM initialiser, possibly a prefix of a bigger array); count/type: the element count and type. tools/scripts/gen_map_tables.py writes gamedata/maps/<map>/tables.json from it. Maintained by hand.

exe_owned._comment: Overlay words the executable now keeps itself, one copy for every map: the weather words and the old particle arrays, the effect slot table of the header and the three words the story characters' waypoint walk shares (sh::maps::PathWalk, reset at every map load). No overlay defines them and no registry lists them; the exe clears its copy at every map load, which equals the fill because their disc bytes are zero in every map (gen_map_tables.py --check-exe-owned). The entries below stay as the record of where they lie on the disc.
